instruction: Navigate to this website using a new tab.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening a new tab with the same website, resulting in two tabs with the same URL. The evaluator uses the existing `get_open_tabs_info` getter and `is_expected_tabs` metric to verify that both tabs are open with the correct URL. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_open_tabs_info extracts all open tabs with their URLs from Chrome via CDP
Metric comparison logic is correct: is_expected_tabs compares actual tab URLs against expected URLs using list comparison with URL normalization
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires - two tabs both with the same URL (https://www.mathsisfun.com/games/2048.html)
Expected values are semantically correct: the instruction says 'open a new tab with this website', and the expected result correctly specifies 2 tabs with the same URL
Data flow is correct: getter extracts tab info → metric extracts URLs → metric compares lists → returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
No edge case issues: the evaluator will work correctly at runtime with the Chrome CDP connection
